description: This is a C# source code file defining the SetupController class for handling setup operations in an OrchardCore module, including setup process, token validation, and configuration copying.

classes.name: SetupController
classes.description: Controller handling the setup process, including rendering setup view, processing setup form submissions, and token validation.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the setup page, initializes the setup model with current settings.

methods.name: IndexPOST
methods.description: Handles POST requests to process setup form submissions, validates input, and initiates setup process.

methods.name: CopyShellSettingsValues
methods.description: Copies relevant shell settings into the setup view model.

methods.name: ShouldProceedWithTokenAsync
methods.description: Checks if the provided token is valid for proceeding with setup.

methods.name: IsTokenValid
methods.description: Validates the token by decrypting and comparing with stored secret.
